svg.title: Let M sensor items gj have nonnegative exact rational costs cj. An item can return several bits. An independently specified decidable family F ⊆2[M] declares jointly feasible selections; it may encode incompatibility, resource caps or prerequisites. It need not be upward closed. The realized readout for selection A is eA(x) = (π(x), (gj(x))j∈A), c(A) = ∑︂ j∈A cj.
